label: 室内纹理
description: 根据单张楼层掩码网格，用四种算法生成室内地板纹理分布（普通/青苔/裂纹/木/石板），输出单张多值网格（每格为纹理 id 1～5 或 0）与名称清单。网格列表由引擎按 DataTree 自动逐张 fanout。
description-en: Generate indoor floor texture distribution from a single floor mask using four algorithms. Outputs one multi-value grid (each cell is texture id 1–5 or 0) and a name list. The engine fans out a DataTree of grids one-by-one.
icon: 扁平插画风格小图标。方形网格内分布三种颜色区块，模拟地板纹理分区，边角处颜色较深，中央区域较浅，主色2种。

inputs.name: inputGrid
inputs.label: 楼层掩码
inputs.description: 单张二维楼层掩码网格（grid[y][x]）；非零单元格视为有效地板区域。网格列表由引擎按 DataTree 自动逐张 fanout。
inputs.description-en: A single 2D floor mask grid (grid[y][x]); non-zero cells are valid floor positions. The engine fans out a DataTree of grids one-by-one.

inputs.name: algorithm
inputs.label: 算法
inputs.description: 纹理生成算法：nature=噪声+边缘衰减，water=环境因素，smooth=聚类平滑，mixed=混合
inputs.description-en: Texture algorithm: nature=noise+edge decay, water=environment factors, smooth=cluster smooth, mixed=hybrid.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.label: 随机种子
inputs.description: 随机种子，0 使用当前时间戳

outputs.name: outputGrid
outputs.label: 纹理网格
outputs.description: 单张多值纹理网格，每格为纹理 id（1=普通,2=青苔,3=裂纹,4=木,5=石板）或 0；下游可按值拆分。输入为网格列表时引擎逐张产出对应的 DataTree。
outputs.description-en: A single multi-value texture grid; each cell is a texture id (1–5) or 0. With a grid-list input the engine emits one per branch as a DataTree.

outputs.name: nameList
outputs.label: 名称清单
outputs.description: 实际出现的纹理条目，格式 [{id, name, type:"tile"}]，按 id 1→5 有序
outputs.description-en: Texture entries actually present, [{id, name, type:"tile"}], ordered id 1→5.
